review:
Hot Slot: Diamond Coins merges two Wazdan series: the retro Hot Slot look and the Coins bonus. It plays on 15 reels with two paylines for regular wins, where special Hot Slot symbols add extra rewards.

Cash Infinity symbols appear as sticky red symbols that stay on the reels and make the bonus more likely. The bonus is Hold the Jackpot, with a Grand Jackpot of 3,000x the bet. Chance Level lets you raise the bet to increase the probability of the bonus. Wazdan lists high volatility and a 96.18% RTP. If you like the Coins games but want more happening in the base game, this is a good one to try.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
